analysis.title: GS Crypto: Weekly Recap- Positioning Reset
key_insights: BTC fell to a new cycle low near $55.3k on Saturday, breaking below its June trough, then rebounded above $60k.
Perp liquidations amplified the move, with $1.4bn of BTC positions liquidated across Friday and Saturday (Coinglass), and thin weekend liquidity likely added to the drop.
The break below June lows challenges the historical pattern where reclaiming the 200-day moving average after a prolonged downtrend signaled a cycle trough. BTC regained its 200DMA in August.
The sell-off came with broad risk deterioration: NDX -10.43% and SPX -8.61% on the week, and gold -8.9% despite lower Treasury yields.
US spot BTC ETFs saw -$1.8bn weekly outflows, leaving cumulative net inflows since the 19 August inflection within ~$564m of being fully unwound.
The August rally was driven mainly by non-ETF spot and perps buying, with ETF demand arriving after prices had risen. GS reads the outflows as a reset of ETF positioning.
BTC MVRV Z-score revisited 0.18, the June level, versus -0.49 at 2018 lows and -0.36 at 2022 lows.
BTC realized price is near $53k (Coinmetrics), about 4% below Saturday's low. Further downside would pressure holders who are still in profit.
Low MVRV readings have historically coincided with attractive long-term entries but have not always marked the exact bottom.
Options reflected the move: 25d risk reversals hit levels last seen in February 2026, showing elevated downside demand. 1M ATM implied vol traded to 47v versus 1M realized at 40v.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Sharp equity drawdown accompanied the BTC sell-off, showing broad risk-off.
Broad risk deterioration coincided with crypto weakness.
Gold fell despite lower Treasury yields, so it did not act as a haven.

crypto_views: BTC hit a new cycle low near $55.3k and rebounded above $60k, with $1.4bn of perp liquidations.
The August 200DMA reclaim no longer supports a new-uptrend view after the retest of lower lows.
US spot BTC ETF outflows of -$1.8bn nearly erased net inflows accumulated since 19 August, leaving ~$564m.
MVRV Z-score at 0.18 and realized price near $53k point to valuations nearing late-cycle stress levels.
risk_factors: Further downside toward the ~$53k realized price could pressure profitable holders.
Weekend thin liquidity and leveraged perp positioning can amplify moves.
Low MVRV readings have not always marked the exact market bottom.
Continued ETF outflows could fully unwind the post-19 August net inflows.

tension_points.bull_case: Low MVRV and spot near realized price have historically coincided with attractive long-term entries, and ETF positioning has reset.
tension_points.bear_case: BTC broke June lows after reclaiming the 200DMA, which undermines the historical recovery pattern. Further downside would pressure profitable holders.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A sustained move below the ~$53k realized price would deepen stress, and MVRV readings have not always marked the exact bottom.
